name: Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S.A.
summary: Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S.A. provides education services in Brazil. The company offers higher education; distance education under the Cruzeiro do Sul Virtual brand; and medical courses. It also operates schools under the Colégio Alto Padrão; Colégio Ceunsp Itu which provides infant, elementary, and highschool education services; Colégio Ceunsp Salto offers basic education, kidergarden, and highschool education services; and Colégio Cruzeiro do Sul that offers kindergarten, high school, and technical school services. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
